title: Protocol for in vivo and ex vivo assessment of hyperglycemia and islet function in diabetic mice
protocol: Fast mice for 6 hours with access to autoclaved water only.
Prepare 0.05 g/mL glucose solution in saline.
Label mice with ear tags or marker pens.
Measure the fasting blood glucose level from tail veins using a blood glucose meter.
Calculate D-glucose volume (1 g/kg body weight) based on mouse body weight.
Inject D-glucose intraperitoneally and start timing.
Measure blood glucose levels at 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, and 120 minutes after injection.
Fast mice for 6 h with free access to autoclaved water.
Prepare 0.15 g/mL glucose solution in saline.
Label the mice with ear tags or marker pens.
Scale mice body weight and calculate D-glucose volume (3 g/kg bodyweight) according to the body weight.
Inject D-glucose into mice in sequence and start timing.
Measure blood glucose levels at 0, 2, 5, and 15 min after glucose injection from tail-tip bleeding.
Centrifuge the blood by 5,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Collect the plasma and store at -80°C for later use.
Determine plasma insulin levels using an insulin ultra-sensitive kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Pause if measurements of insulin level will be done on another day, and store plasma at -80°C.
Fix pancreas tissues in 10% neutral phosphate buffered formalin for 24 h at room temperature (22°C).

Dehydrate pancreas tissues through graded increasing ethanol concentrations (50%, 70%, 95%, and 100%) for 2 hours each at room temperature, acetone for 30 minutes, and chloroform for 30 minutes at 60°C.
Embed pancreas tissues in paraffin.
Slice serial pancreatic sections at 6 μm thickness and place on histological glass slide.
Deparaffinize pancreatic paraffin sections in xylene at room temperature (22°C).
Rehydrate sections in 100% ethanol for 5 min.
Rehydrate sections in 95% ethanol for 5 min.
Rehydrate sections in 70% ethanol for 5 min.
Rehydrate sections in 50% ethanol for 5 min.
Rehydrate sections in water for 5 min.
Block sections with 5% normal goat serum for 30 min.
Incubate sections with rabbit anti-insulin at a dilution of 1:500 overnight (8 h) at 4°C.
Incubate sections with biotin-conjugated goat anti-rabbit at a dilution of 1:200 for 45 min at room temperature.
Incubate sections with HRP-streptavidin at a dilution of 1:500 for 30 min at room temperature.
Detect insulin positive area with AEC chromogenic agent for 1 min at room temperature.
Counterstain slides with hematoxylin for 10 s at room temperature.
Scan whole pancreatic tissue sections with the Olympus VS120 Whole Slide Scanner.
Quantify total islet number per pancreas.
Identify and quantify each islet area in μm² using Image-Pro Plus and scale bar from whole section picture.
Quantify islet numbers of different size groups including <1,000 μm²/islet, 1,000–5,000 μm²/islet, 5,000–15,000 μm²/islet, >15,000 μm²/islet.
Store pancreatic paraffin slide storage box at room temperature if staining will be resumed on another day.
Hand-pick up 25 similar size islets from each group.
Culture islets in RPMI 1640 medium with 10% FBS overnight (8 h) after isolation.
Culture islets in medium containing 2.8 mM glucose for 0.5, 1, or 1.5 hours.
Culture islets in medium containing 16.7 mM glucose for 0.5, 1, or 1.5 hours.
Collect culture medium from each group.
Determine media insulin levels by insulin ultra-sensitive kit according to the manufacturer’s instruction.
Normalize media insulin levels to per mg of islets protein.
Hand-pick up 40 similar size islets from each group.
Culture islets in RPMI 1640 medium with 10% FBS overnight (8 h) after isolation.
Culture islets in medium containing 16.7 mM glucose for 24 hours.
Centrifuge and resuspend islets in 200 μL PBS.
Place slides and filters into slots with the cardboard filters appropriately.
Quickly move 200 μL of each sample into the appropriate wells of the cytospin.
Cytospin each group of islets to slides by 2,000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Remove the filters from their slides carefully and wait for air dry.
Fix slides with cold acetone for 5 minutes.
Wash slides in PBS for 3 times after air dry.
Block islet sections with 5% normal goat serum for 30 minutes.
Immunofluorescent co-localization stain islet sections with 5% normal goat serum containing rabbit anti-Ki67 (1:100) and rat anti-insulin (1:500) antibodies overnight at 4°C.
Wash slides in PBS for 3 times.
Incubate sections in 5% normal goat serum containing Alex Fluor 555-labeled goat anti-rabbit (1:300) and Alex Fluor 488-labeled donkey anti-rat (1:500) secondary antibodies for 30 minutes.
Wash slides in PBS for 3 times.
Incubate sections in 0.4 μM DAPI for 10 minutes.
Cover slide with coverslips in mounting medium.
Capture images with Olympus confocal microscopy.
Hand-pick up 40 similar size islets from each group and culture islets in RPMI 1640 medium with 10% FBS overnight at 8 hours after isolation.
Pulse isolated WT islets with 5 μg/mL BrdU for 2 hours.
Disperse islets with 1 mL fresh accutase for 10 minutes at 37°C incubator with 5% CO2.
Wash islet cells in PBS once.
Block islet cells with Fc block (1:100) in FACS buffer for 20 minutes.
Wash islet cells in PBS once.
Label islet cells with Alexa Fluor 647 anti-insulin (1 μg/mL) and FITC anti-BrdU (1 μg/mL) or isotypes for 30 minutes in intracellular staining buffer according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Perform flow cytometry analysis using a FACS Analyzer LSR Fortessa (BD Biosciences) or other Flow Cytometer.
Hand-pick up 40 similar size islets from each group.
Culture isolated islets in RPMI 1640 medium with 10% FBS overnight (8 hours).
Pulse isolated WT islets with 5 μg/mL BrdU for 2 hours.
Cytospin each group of islets to slides following the steps 47–51.
Wash sections.
Fix sections.
Block sections.
Immunofluorescent co-localization stain islet sections with 5% normal goat serum containing mouse anti-BrdU (1:100) and rat anti-insulin (1:500) antibodies overnight at 4°C.
Wash slides in PBS for three times.
Incubate sections in 5% normal goat serum containing Alex Fluor 555-labeled goat anti-mouse and Alex Fluor 488-labeled donkey anti-rat secondary antibodies for 30 minutes.
Wash the slides.
Cover the slides.
Capture images following steps 58–60.
If staining of BrdU will be done on another day, store the slide at −80°C after fixation.
Hand-pick up 40 similar size islets from each group.
Culture islets in RPMI 1640 medium with 10% FBS overnight (8 hours) at 37°C.
Stimulate islets with 50 mM STZ for 30 minutes.
Cytospin each group of islets to slides following steps 47–51.
Wash the sections.
Fix the sections.
Block the sections.
Immunofluorescent co-localization stain islet sections with 5% normal goat serum containing rabbit anti-Cleaved caspase 3 and rat anti-insulin antibodies overnight (8 hours) at 4°C.
Wash slides in PBS for three times.
Incubate sections in 5% normal goat serum containing Alex Fluor 555-labeled goat anti-rabbit and Alex Fluor 488-labeled donkey anti-rat secondary antibodies for 30 minutes at room temperature (22°C).
Wash the slides again.
Cover the slides.
Capture images following steps 58–60.
If staining of Cleaved caspase 3 will be done on another day, store the slide at −80°C after fixation.
Hand-pick up 40 similar size islets from each group.
Culture islets in RPMI 1640 medium with 10% FBS overnight (8 h) after isolation.
Culture islets in medium containing 50 μM adenosine dialdehyde for 72 hours at 37°C incubator with 5% CO2.
Disperse, wash, and block islets cells.
Stain islets with Alexa Fluor 647 anti-insulin (1 μg/mL) and PE anti-glucagon (1 μg/mL).
Perform flow cytometry analysis using a FACS Analyzer LSR.
Quantify Glucagon+, Ins+, and Glucagon+Ins+cells in each group of islets.
Culture islets in medium containing 50 μM adenosine dialdehyde (Adox) for 72 h at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Cytospin each group of islets to slides following steps 47–51.
Wash sections.
Fix sections.
Block sections.
Immunofluorescent co-localization stain islet sections with 5% normal goat serum containing mouse anti-Glucagon (1:200) and rat anti-insulin (1:500) antibodies overnight at 4°C.
Wash slides in PBS for 3 times.
Incubate sections in 5% normal goat serum containing Alex Fluor 555-labeled goat anti-mouse (1:300) and Alex Fluor 488-labeled donkey anti-rat (1:500) secondary antibodies for 30 min.
Wash slides.
Cover slides.
Capture images following steps 58–60.
